messages:
nina: Heads-up: post-webinar push next Tue. We want a LinkedIn carousel + X thread to drive on-demand signups and SDR handoffs. Need creative, copy, and tracking.

leo: Can we reuse the demo GIF from the live demo? Also want a 4-card carousel: pain -> benchmark -> demo snippet -> CTA.

alex: GIF exists: /mkt/webinar/assets/demo_clip_v2.gif. I'll export carousel cards once copy is final. What copy angles are we testing?

nina: Two angles: 1) Performance-first (latency/cost benchmark), 2) Developer experience (integration + SDK). Keep cards short.

sam: Scheduling wise, propose LinkedIn carousel (AM) then X thread (PM) same day. X thread should lead with a crisp benchmark stat and include replies with a short explainer and the on-demand link.

maria: SDR routing: we need two UTM variants to route to either sdr-inbound-north or sdr-inbound-south. Also add a param `source=webinar_followup`. We'll test which creative drives better MQL%.

ops-bot: @maria I can create tracked links. Paste base URL and utm_content values.

maria: Base: https://redwood.ai/webinar/on-demand ; utm_content=carA, carB.

ops-bot: Generated links:
`https://redwood.ai/webinar/on-demand?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_followup&utm_content=carA&source=webinar_followup`
`https://redwood.ai/webinar/on-demand?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_followup&utm_content=carB&source=webinar_followup`
`https://redwood.ai/webinar/on-demand?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_followup&utm_content=carA&source=webinar_followup`
`https://redwood.ai/webinar/on-demand?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_followup&utm_content=carB&source=webinar_followup`

leo: Nice. Card mapping suggestion:
- carA: performance-first cards + CTA -> link variant carA
- carB: dev-experience cards + CTA -> link variant carB

alex: I'll push export to /mkt/webinar/followup/carousels/: `carA_4up_v1.png`, `carB_4up_v1.png`, and upload X thread GIFs: `gif_snippet_v2.gif`.

nina: Copy drafts (short):
- Perf headline: "45ms p50. 0.08¢/token. See how we cut inference cost."
- Dev headline: "Ship features faster with a production-ready inference stack."
- CTA card: "Watch on-demand + get playbook"

sam: X thread structure (suggested):
```
Tweet 1: stat highlight + link (carA or carB)
Reply 1: quick snapshot of test setup + p50/p95
Reply 2: short gif demo + integration note
Reply 3: CTA + SDR routing note
```

maria: SDR webhook mapping: utm_content=carA => sdr-inbound-north, carB => sdr-inbound-south. Also set lead.priority=medium if source=webinar_followup. Runbook link: https://intranet/redwood/sdr-playbooks/webinar-followup.

nina: Can we add a small benchmark footnote on the carousel card 2: "benchmark run: 8xA100, seq=1024, batch=16" — Leo, can you add that small text (legible)?

leo: Yep. Will add small caption. Also will ensure the GIF loop is trimmed to 3s to keep file <5MB.

alex: Timing propose (PST): LinkedIn 9:30am, X thread at 5:00pm to catch commute scroll. Sam to schedule.

sam: Scheduling now. Which creative goes to which audience segment? We should push Performance to accounts + engineering clusters, Dev-experience to product/PM audiences. I'll tag audience lists.

maria: Reminder: test_name in CRM should be `webinar_followup_carA_vs_carB` and create two lead tags `wf_carA`, `wf_carB`.

nina: Follow-ups: alex deliver exports by EOD today, leo upload updated GIF, sam schedule posts + include rotated links, maria pre-run webhook test with a sample request.

ops-bot: Quick webhook test example (no PII):
`POST https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead?url=https://redwood.ai/webinar/on-demand?utm_source=linkedin&utm_content=carA&source=webinar_followup`
Response: 200 OK (created contact id 12345)

sam: All set on scheduler, I'll rotate the links between carA/carB across LinkedIn and X as specified. Will post back when live.

nina: Thanks team 680. Let's collect performance by EOW and decide next retargeting push.
